research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: imgix is engaged in research and development focused on dynamically serving image metadata, as described in the work titled Dynamic service of image metadata. The disclosed methods and systems enable an image service system to receive requests for images and serve associated inherent metadata, supporting efficient management and delivery of image information. This area of research addresses the processing and optimization of image metadata for improved image delivery.

overview_description.description: Imgix combines cutting-edge AI, data, and visual intelligence to help businesses grow through impactful visual media. With over 60,000 customers and serving more than 8 billion image requests daily, Imgix delivers tools that optimize visual content for performance, accessibility, and personalization. Leveraging AI-powered features like intelligent cropping, background removal and replacement, text-to-image and image-to-video, Imgix empowers brands such as Porsche, Unsplash, Skims, and thousands more to create engaging experiences, improve SEO, and scale content delivery effortlessly. By uniting innovation with a relentless focus on customer success, Imgix is redefining how businesses harness visual media to drive results.

about_short_description.short_description: Imgix is the platform for managing, processing, rendering, optimizing, and delivering your digital media.

product.name: Image Optimization and Delivery Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages, processes, optimizes, and delivers images in real time across digital platforms and devices.

product.name: Auto-Tagging
product.description: An automated image tagging service that identifies and labels objects within images to facilitate organization and searchability.

product.name: Focal-Point Crop
product.description: A cropping tool that focuses on a specified point within an image to maintain important content during resizing or cropping.

product.name: Generative Fill and Background Removal
product.description: Image editing features that enable automatic background removal and generative filling to modify image backgrounds or fill areas.

product.name: Auto-Compress
product.description: An automatic image compression service that reduces file size while maintaining visual quality to improve loading times.
